notes.title: Nothorian: Real-time action with infinite builds
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44395917/49b4b9e24d9456c28644ea94f00e391c0f98c99d.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][i]We're almost there to reach 20,000 downloads in Steam Libraries, thank you so much for that![/i][/p][p][i]Nothorian is getting closer to being perfected for release at the end of the year.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Nothorian — Full-on action, deep builds, and real danger![/b][/p][p]Nothorian evolves. With the integration of Kadajah's Action Battle System (ABS), our world becomes a frenetic and strategic action-RPG: real-time combat on the map, deep builds thanks to 12 gear slots, wave zones that test your reflexes, and defined heroes that represent contrasting playstyles.[/p][p]Be prepared to jump, shoot, rend, and die (if you don't act wisely).[/p][p]Two heroes, two combat styles[/p][p][/p][p]🪓 [b]The Butcher[/b][/p][p]A brutal and ruthless warrior who turns proximity into an advantage.[/p][p]Style: Melee, high base damage, specializing in tearing apart groups of nearby enemies.[/p][p]Advantages: High-impact and fast melee strikes, enemy attack interruption, superior durability thanks to his gear, and health regeneration.[/p][p]Challenges: Requires good dash/jump management to reposition; If he's surrounded and doesn't use his abilities accurately, he can fall quickly.[/p][p]Best for: Players who enjoy being in the thick of combat, risking everything, and dominating the rhythm of the waves.[/p][p][/p][p]🔫 [b]The Gunman[/b][/p][p]A cunning and fast marksman who controls the battlefield from a distance.[/p][p]Style: Evasion, mobility, and Critical Hits; he combines normal and special shots.[/p][p]Advantages: Natural kiting, ranged attacks with elemental affinity, high mobility for dodging and repositioning.[/p][p]Challenges: Fragile in close combat; requires good aim and resource management.[/p][p]Best for: Tactical players who prefer to calculate angles, keep enemies at bay, and exploit elemental weaknesses.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][list][*][p][u]Equipment: 12 slots = a multitude of builds[/u][/p][/*][*][p][u]Each hero has 12 equipment slots, allowing you to build unique builds based on your style.[/u][/p][/*][*][p][u]Three active sets saved and ready to switch between in seconds (1/2/3 or Tab). Go from tank to agile assassin without pausing combat; it works as an arsenal for your builds.[/u][/p][/*][*][p][u]Stats Screen: All the info in real time.[/u][/p][/*][*][p][u]Hold Left Ctrl to view a detailed panel with:[/u][/p][/*][*][p][u]HP and MP regeneration.[/u][/p][/*][*][p][u]Attack speed, base damage, critical attacks, and evasion.[/u][/p][/*][*][p][u]Elemental affinities and active bonuses.[/u][/p][/*][*][p][u]Enemies and bosses defeated.[/u][/p][/*][*][p][u]Cooldowns and number of available potions.[/u][/p][/*][*][p][u]A vital board that defines your builds and gives you control over your survival.[/u][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][list][*][p]Q and E: Quick potions.[/p][/*][*][p]Q → Health potion.[/p][/*][*][p]E → Mana potion.[/p][/*][*][p]Both have a shared cooldown.[/p][/*][*][p]Life-saving mobility.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][list][*][p]Jump/Dash (V): Dodge attacks, cross gaps, reach tall structures, and create an offensive advantage.[/p][/*][*][p]8 movement directions: Precise control to flank and avoid projectiles.[/p][/*][*][p]Action Zones and Waves: The Heart of the Challenge[/p][/*][*][p]Progressive waves: From basic mobs to elites and minibosses.[/p][/*][*][p]Lethal composition: Healers, tanks, projectiles, and traps force you to think carefully about every move.[/p][/*][*][p]Bosses: AoE attacks with indicators, complex patterns.[/p][/*][*][p]Dangerous environments: Traps, jump sites, projectile passages.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]👉 [b]Warning: If you don't act wisely, waves will destroy you. Button mashing isn't enough: you need mobility, timing, and thoughtful builds.[/b][/p][p]Visual feedback and immersive UX[/p][p]Health and mana bars on heroes and enemies.[/p][p]HUD with cooldowns and potions.[/p][p]Real-time damage, critical hits, and status pop-ups.[/p][p]Unique animations for each weapon, ability, or element.[/p][p][/p][p][u][b]The Future of Nothorian[/b][/u][/p][p]Now every fight is a spectacle:[/p][p]Butcher and Gunslinger define opposing styles to survive the chaos.[/p][p]Builds with 12 slots and interchangeable sets allow you to create your own strategy.[/p][p]Waves and bosses turn each area into a unique battlefield.[/p][p]Welcome to the new Nothorian: a world where action, strategy, and danger blend at every turn.[/p][p][/p][p]\[Nothorian will be leaving Early Access soon with its release.][/p]

notes.title: Nothorian: alcanza las 15.000 descargas en bibliotecas.
notes.notes: [p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=d4Ho0XW7ho0"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44395917/03a2583cf51190bc24e49089ff3a69fc36cd7285.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]15,000 Steam Downloads: An Unexpected Milestone[/p][p]It's truly astonishing to see Nothorian reach 15,000 downloads on Steam, even though its release isn't scheduled until 2026. From that first scribble in a notebook eight years ago, this project has been a five-year journey of hard work, passion, and dedication that I never imagined would resonate so deeply. This milestone is more than a number; it's the tangible manifestation of a dark and light dream that grows with each player who awaits this unique event.[/p][p]Nothorian is a universe of profound contrasts whose powers intertwine with the very essence of the world, as the Hell Lords Verudor, Cazythul, and Belphegor extend their dominion of terror and despair alongside what will come with the awakening of the Prismatic Dragon Keratir. But beyond these shadows, 5,000 years later, on the other side of the looking glass, lies a beacon of hope and progress: the planet Xylonis.[/p][p]Xylonis is not only the technological jewel of the Nothorian universe, but also the gateway to parallel realities and alternate universes. There, science has broken the barriers of time and space, revealing secrets that defied all logic and could change the fate of our world and beyond. It is on Xylonis where the forces that allow access to mirror universes converge, and where technology coexists with ancient and forgotten magic.[/p][p]This planet, with its colossal cities filled with crystal towers and pulsating energy, is the epicenter of a silent battle: the struggle to control the balance between realities. For in each parallel universe, different versions of Nothorian exist, some mired in ruin, others just beginning their struggle, but all connected by the delicate thread of destiny.[/p][p]The secrets held by Xylonis are projects to open interdimensional portals, investigate, and uncover the mystery of essence itself, understanding not only our world, but eternity itself.[/p][p]Every download and message of support fuels this passion, this living story we build together. Thanks to you, this odyssey of darkness and light continues to grow, expanding into new horizons and dimensions.[/p][p]But this is just the beginning. The Nothorian universe is vast, intertwining destinies and realities with gameplay that will soon reveal new layers of mystery and power. Together, with this incredible community, we will open doors to the unknown, challenging both the darkness and the light.[/p][p]As a gift for your support, we present the first Nothorian cinematic, an exclusive preview that will give you a glimpse into this diverse world of legends, lore, and shadows.[/p]
